subject: Pilot success routes and owner slate
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@orchardai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot success routes and owner slate

Alex — great to meet today. Quick written recap from our discovery call and proposed path to a 30-day pilot so we have a single source of truth. TL;DR: kickoff week of Oct 4, weekly syncs, final readout after 30 days.

Goals / success criteria (proposed)
- Performance: median latency < 200ms, 95th percentile < 500ms for typical 512-token calls
- Quality: >85% pass rate on your customer intent test set (we'll run blinded evals)
- Economics: target cost per 1k tokens <$0.50 by using batching + prefix cache
- Security: data stay in your VPC sandbox; no long-term storage of raw PII test records

Evaluation plan
1) Shared test harness and sample prompts (you provide ~500 representative queries)
2) Redwood provides sandbox endpoint + runbook for telemetry collection
3) Weekly readout: small metric dashboard + short qualitative notes
4) Final readout: metrics, sample failures, recommendations for production rollout

Timeline & cadence
- Share sample dataset and NDA/procurement asks by Wed 9/24 (Alex / procurement)
- Redwood to deliver sandbox + initial metrics dashboard by Fri 10/01
- Kickoff: week of Oct 4 — propose Tue 10/05 11:00 PT for an hour
- Weekly check-ins: 30 minutes each Tuesday during pilot
- Final readout: 30 days after kickoff (presentation + exec summary)

Owners (initial)
- Ben Carter (Sales / technical lead) — program owner, escalation contact
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — onboarding, acceptance criteria, readouts
- Jonas Weber (SRE / infra) — sandbox, perf baselining, KV cache tuning

Attachments sent: orchard-poc-scope.pdf (scope + acceptance matrix), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (timeline & responsibilities). I dropped a short SOC2 summary as soc2-summary-link.txt with pointer to our security page as requested.

Next steps for Alex/procurement:
- Confirm kickoff date/time that works with your infra and product teams
- Share the representative prompt set and any redline requirements for the MSA

If this matches your view I’ll: upload the scope to the shared Drive, circulate a calendar invite once we lock kickoff, and ask Marissa to confirm resource allocation.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

- Two other folks who should be on kickoff: Lina Park (Product) and Marco Ruiz (Infra). I’ll loop them in once we confirm time.

Test data guidance: hashed PII is fine as long as you provide a mapping file (kept out of the sandbox). Tokenized placeholders are also acceptable if you prefer not to share mappings. We’ll provide a short ingestion script and validation checks to ensure prompt fidelity.

Kickoff / attendees: Tue 10/05 11:00 PT works for Redwood. Please confirm Lina and Marco — if they can’t make that time we can do Wed 10/06 10:00 PT as backup. Once you confirm we’ll send a calendar invite and attach the MIP + readout template.

- Marissa to confirm availability for weekly check-ins and final readout slides

Marissa — can you confirm we have 1x CS engineer allocated Tue mornings during Oct for the weekly 30-min syncs and who will own the final readout slide deck?

Thanks,
Ben
